question: Can the ECW-308 value 36.00 (25 C) be traced to a publicly retrievable document that also states the temperature, given that the cited Perricone et al. 2013 paper is closed access?
answer: Yes for both the value and the temperature. The open-access doctoral thesis of the same first author reports eps_r = 36 for methoxypropionitrile with an explicit 25 C condition in two tables: Tableau 4 (printed page 28, permittivity column headed 'eps_r a 25 C') and Tableau 14 (printed page 77, property row headed 'Constante dielectrique a 25 C', column MP). An earlier pass recorded the temperature as unstated because it read only Tableau 12, which lists the same value without a temperature note.

source.title_fr: Mise au point d'electrolytes innovants et performants pour supercondensateurs
source.title_en: Development of innovative and effective electrolytes for capacitors
source.author: Perricone, Emmanuelle
source.retrieved_with: Microsoft Edge launched through Playwright (channel=msedge). Direct HTTP fetches returned the HAL/Anubis proof-of-work interstitial (12,537 bytes of HTML); the browser executed the challenge and the PDF was then fetched from the same authenticated context.
source.extracted_text_sha256_convention: Content hash of the extracted text after normalising CRLF line endings to LF (UTF-8). The worktree copy of the .txt is stored with CRLF, so its raw byte hash is d48e684c0081a79f203664b995d0fbbc4ba17425fc557fcaa26754b7afb9e70d; normalising CRLF to LF reproduces dc2272fe98b15fed89ba00b9c43aa8472ff0e93e7561cdea78bc3e9900be3fa7 exactly.

evidence.location: Tableau 4 and Tableau 14 state the temperature; Tableau 12 also lists the value but states no condition
evidence.table_caption_fr: Tableau 4 : Caracteristiques des principaux solvants utilises pour la fabrication des electrolytes : famille des carbonates, esters, ethers et nitriles (page 28); Tableau 14 : Proprietes des solvants utilises (page 77); Tableau 12 : Proprietes physico-chimiques des solvants (page 65)
evidence.tableau_14_permittivity_row: Constante dielectrique a 25 C | EC 90 | GV 34 | S 43 (30 C) | AM 6.7 | AE 6 | MP 36 | MMOA - | MIPA - | EDFA - | BN 25 [107] | PC 64,4 [106] | ACN 36
evidence.note: Tableau 4's permittivity column is headed 'eps_r a 25 C' and the methoxypropionitrile row carries no per-cell temperature override, so 36 is a 25 C value. Tableau 14 is a transposed property matrix whose viscosity row is the one annotated 'a 40 C'; its permittivity row is headed 'Constante dielectrique a 25 C' and gives 36 under the MP column. Three other cells in that same row anchor the column alignment: sulfolane 43 (30 C), propylene carbonate 64,4 and ethylene carbonate 90, all matching values the same thesis states elsewhere. Tableau 12 carries neither a temperature footnote nor a reference letter, and reading it alone is why the temperature was previously recorded as unstated. The 165 C boiling point and 66 C flash point match handbook values for 3-methoxypropionitrile, which anchors the rows to the right compound.

perricone_2013_paper.note: Same first author as the thesis; the paper is the document ECW-308 cites.

corroboration.independence: not independent: both documents belong to the same author's research line. The thesis is an independent *document* (peer-visible, public, and predating the 2013 paper) but not an independent measurement lineage.

decision.evidence_level: corroborated_by_author_thesis (value and the 25 C condition are both stated in the open-access thesis); the value itself remains a secondary compilation
decision.model_ready: unchanged (false) - the direct cause is the curated exclusion (data/processed/dielectric_v03_exclusions.csv: secondary compilation awaiting primary confirmation); the row additionally has no GFN2-xTB physical-feature row at all, which is an independent precondition and is not part of the failed_physical_feature_* bucket (that bucket only counts feature rows that exist with status=error)
decision.correction: The v0.3.5 patch and probe recorded the temperature as unstated after reading Tableau 12 alone. Tableau 4 and Tableau 14 state 25 C, so the v0.3.10 revision corrected the note, this probe and reports/g1plus_mopn_thesis_findings.md. No dielectric, T_K or model_ready value changed.
follow_up: Two independent blockers must both clear before the row can be fitted: resolve the primary-confirmation exclusion, and run GFN2-xTB features for COCCC#N.

Thesis Tableaux 4, 5-8 and 14 also list eps_r for acetonitrile, benzonitrile, gamma-valerolactone, propylene carbonate and others with per-value references and/or a 25 C header - a candidate cross-check source for the solvent family.
Tableau 14 gives gamma-valerolactone 34 while Tableau 8 gives 32 (ref [87]), so the thesis disagrees with itself; both stay secondary relays in the open GVL conflict ticket.
